name: smtp4dev Local Email Testing
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause-licensed local fake SMTP server for testing email flows, with web UI, IMAP/POP3 access, SMTP logs and HTML preview; no software usage quota or hosted sending allowance.
watch_out: Not a production email delivery service. Requires user-provided Windows, Linux, macOS or container runtime and storage; local/CI infrastructure costs are separate. SMTP relay features can send real messages if explicitly configured; protect the testing server from public exposure.
